quests.title: The Printed Compact
quests.summary: Carry a merchant compact from Lisbon to London and secure its recognition without assuming either city remains under its first ruler.

objectives.text: Reach London or its lawful successor administration.
Win recognition through the current diplomatic authority.
Deposit a copy with a surviving printing institution.
Report to the compact's sponsors in Lisbon.

quests.title: Leaves of the Niger
quests.summary: Protect Timbuktu's manuscript trade while the Niger's rulers and roads change.

objectives.text: Search the western Sahel for the manuscript caravan.
Defeat or deter the force threatening the caravan route.
Trade for replacement paper and fund new copies.
Return the surviving work to Timbuktu's current custodians.

quests.title: Stars and Pepper
quests.summary: Join Calicut's pepper market to safer celestial navigation and keep the work alive if its first scholar is absent.

objectives.text: Complete a pepper trade at Calicut under its current controller.
Consult Krishnadevaraya if he is available and willing.
Obtain observations from Calicut's pilot guild instead.
Complete the celestial-navigation research needed for the table.

quests.title: The Strait Accord
quests.summary: Keep Malacca's strait open through negotiation or convoy action during commercial competition.

objectives.text: Hear the petitions raised by competition in the Malacca Strait.
Broker passage with Malacca's current diplomatic authority.
Protect a neutral convoy without claiming control of the route.
Record the outcome at Malacca.

quests.title: The Coastal Record
quests.summary: Reconcile official coastal records with the testimony of sailors and admirals.

objectives.text: Receive the court's coastal-trade order.
Seek Yi Sun-sin's account if he is present and not hostile.
Inspect Quanzhou's harbor ledger as alternate testimony.
Apply the evidence to standardized charts.

quests.title: Messages of the Highlands
quests.summary: Carry news between Cusco's road stations without exposing a refuge named only in guarded clues.

objectives.text: Ask Malintzin to interpret the foreign report, or use the court interpreters if she is absent.
Follow the guarded clue; no marker identifies the refuge.
Entrust the warning to the surviving court road network.
Deliver the warning despite the succession crisis.

quests.title: Stars Between Islands
quests.summary: Preserve a voyaging exchange whose destination is known first only as an island region.

objectives.text: Learn the star path from Tupaia, or from the voyaging council if he is unavailable.
Seek the exchange somewhere in the Pacific island region.
Recover the route from Hawai'i's voyaging council.
Renew the voyaging exchange between island communities.

quests.title: An Ocean of Accounts
quests.summary: Build a campaign-spanning account of trade, navigation, and political change without presuming any one port, ruler, or route survives.

objectives.text: Compare the Lisbon compact with the restored Niger archive.
Record a viable commercial link between Calicut and Malacca.
Obtain the amended East Asian coastal record.
When the eastern witness is unavailable, substitute a verified chart.
Compare Pacific voyaging knowledge with the guarded highland account.
Return the completed ledger to Lisbon or its successor civic authority.

quests.title: Adriatic Ledgers
quests.summary: A regional dispute joins civic authority, commerce, learned practice, and a changing political settlement.

objectives.text: Record the historical pressure shaping the petition.
Reach terms with the current polity authority.
Apply relevant technical knowledge to an alternate settlement.
Deliver the agreed terms without assuming unchanged control.
Return the result to the petitioners.

quests.title: Adriatic Ledgers: A Personal Reckoning
quests.summary: A recruitable companion weighs private obligations against service, office, and the player's trust.

objectives.text: Earn the companion's confidence.
Use the companion's office to negotiate a durable answer.
Protect the companion's personal obligation at home.
Let the companion judge the chosen outcome.
